site.name: Clyde Mine
overview: Clyde Mine is a documented historic tungsten mine northeast of Nederland in Boulder County. Federal mineral-exploration records identify it as a distinct named property, while Colorado Geological Survey mapping documents substantial underground workings at the site.
moreHistory: Colorado Geological Survey mapping places the Clyde Mine in the northwest quarter of Section 7, Township 1 South, Range 72 West, about 1.5 miles northeast of Nederland, and records overlapping shafts with seven levels and a deep winze.
USGS Data Series 1004 lists Clyde Mine in Boulder County under DMEA docket 4038 as a tungsten property, preserving the mine's identity in federal mineral-exploration records.
